checks.baseline_reason: Corrective review 2026-10-12: trial4 geometric revision and independent sampling correction. Geometry: the front mouth is full 6 mm gap at Z5..49 and outer 2.5 mm gap (Y-34..-31.5) at Z49..58; the existing Z49 support row is continued as the second 1.2 mm mouth mullion. Skin, envelope, CSI, cooler and 510 mm2 hot wall ports are unchanged. Sampling: source rib-face interval midpoints now supplement all original planes; this corrects previously missed narrow cold-rear pillar intervals (the compact isolated body gave 534 mm2 on the old grid versus 522 mm2 at its actual smaller section), not a cold-geometry change. Saved original-kowa_lm6hc manifest 0b467d10 proves hot path 509.999996 and cold path 420.000000 mm2 with the unchanged 0.002 mm2 tolerance. The front minimum neck is 274.20 mm2; cold-rear series minimum is 522.00 mm2. This records a geometric/reporting revision only; the orifice network has no measured fan operating point or thermal qualification.
